facts: Parties: Redcliffe Retail Group plc (Buyer), Fenwick Software Ltd (Seller); the Company is Eskdale Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 15 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 20 July 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 15 April 2027), either party may terminate.

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 20% of the Purchase Price, being $39,600,000. The Purchase Price is $220,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 27 August 2027.
